S11.01.note: Names are set in code for many controls (aria-label in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts); the code audit did not check every control.
steps: Turn on VoiceOver (Command+F5).
Move VoiceOver focus to the Recent chats button at the top right of the side panel, then to the Send message button beside the message box.
Listen: each control should speak a name that says what it does.
Compare with Expected.
S11.01.where: Chat screen, any button or box; seen with VoiceOver

S11.02.note: The Chat panel's top heading is a visually hidden h1 (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts). The Schedules heading on the options page is an h2 at the same level as the Shortcuts section heading (apps/extension/src/features/options/shortcuts-section.ts), so it is not nested under it.
steps: Turn on VoiceOver (Command+F5).
Press VO+U, then choose Headings.
Check that the list has a top heading for the Chat panel and a heading called Recent chats.
Compare with Expected.
S11.02.where: Chat screen and Recent chats; seen in the VoiceOver headings list

S11.03.note: Arrow-key handling was confirmed for the More menu (apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/menu.ts); the model menu keyboard behaviour was not checked in code.
steps: Click an empty part of the side panel, then press Tab over and over; focus should reach the top buttons, the Chat and Computer Use tabs and the message box.
Press Return on the More button, press Down and Up arrow keys, then press Escape.
Press Return on the Recent chats button, press Tab through the sheet, then press Escape.
Compare with Expected: all controls reachable, arrows move through the menu, Escape closes.
S11.03.where: Side panel: Tab key from the top of the panel, then the More menu and Recent chats

labels.text: How can I help you today?

S11.04.note: Focus ring CSS is in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts (button:focus-visible rule); the exact look was not checked in code.
steps: Press Tab repeatedly from the top of the side panel.
Watch the focused control; it should show a clear outline or ring.
Check the message box placeholder and the buttons beside it.
Compare with Expected.
S11.04.where: Side panel: Tab key from the top of the panel, starting near the message box

S11.05.note: Focus move, Tab wrap and Escape are all in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts around the recents sheet code.
steps: Click the Recent chats button (clock icon).
Check that focus moves into the sheet: the search box or the Close recent chats button should be focused.
Press Tab repeatedly; focus should stay inside the sheet and wrap around.
Press Escape; the sheet should close. Compare with Expected.
S11.05.where: Side panel > Recent chats (clock icon at top right)

S11.06.note: Code closes Recent chats and calls focus on the clock button (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts). Focus restoration for the More menu was not checked in code.
steps: Note which button you pressed: the clock icon labelled Recent chats.
Open Recent chats, then close it with Escape or the Close recent chats button.
Check that focus returns to the clock icon (it should show a focus ring).
Compare with Expected.
S11.06.where: Side panel > Recent chats (clock icon at top right)

labels.text: How can I help you today?

S11.07.needs: an account that can get a reply
S11.07.note: Code marks the message log as a polite live region (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts); the exact spoken wording is not in the code.
steps: Turn on VoiceOver (Command+F5).
Click the message box, type a short question and press Return.
When the reply finishes, listen for a short spoken update while VoiceOver focus stays on the box.
Compare with Expected: a short announcement, focus not moved.
S11.07.where: Chat: type in the message box and press Return

labels.text: How can I help you today?

S11.08.needs: an account that can get a reply
S11.08.note: The code audit did not confirm the chunking rule; the live region is in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts.
steps: Turn on VoiceOver (Command+F5).
Click the message box, type a question that needs a long answer, and press Return.
Listen while the answer streams: it should not speak each word, and it should not repeat text.
Compare with Expected.
S11.08.where: Chat: type in the message box and press Return

labels.text: Your approval is required before this tool can run.

S11.09.needs: a task that needs tool approval
S11.09.note: Status and alert roles are in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/bubbles.ts. Which task triggers approval is not in the code audit.
steps: Start a task that makes the agent use a tool which needs approval (the tool depends on the task).
When the card says Your approval is required before this tool can run., check that VoiceOver announces it.
Tab to the Approve and Decline buttons; both should have clear names.
Press Approve, then check that the card shows a recorded status. Compare with Expected.
S11.09.where: Chat: an approval card inside a reply when a tool needs approval

S11.10.needs: a Mac with a touch screen to test touch; the keyboard check works on any Mac
S11.10.note: The always-visible rule is for hover: none devices (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts). A Mac has no touch screen, so touch could not be tested; the keyboard focus rule is the closest check.
steps: Send a message and wait for a reply.
Move the pointer over the reply; the Copy response button should appear.
Press Tab until the Copy response button is focused; it should show now without hovering.
Compare with Expected.
S11.10.where: Chat: any reply; the Copy response button

S11.12.note: The code audit found no location; no in-app text-size control was found in the app code and the rule was not checked in code.
steps: Raise the text size in the browser or OS settings.
Open the side panel and read a chat reply, the Recent chats list and the model menu.
Check that no text is cut off. Compare with Expected.
S11.12.where: Side panel text, after the browser or OS text size is raised

S11.13.note: The code audit found no location, so the reflow rule was not confirmed in code.
steps: Open the side panel in Chrome.
Press Command+Plus in Chrome until the zoom reads 400%.
Check that the layout becomes one column with no horizontal scrollbar.
Compare with Expected.

S11.14.note: The rule is in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts and apps/extension/src/tokens.ts (agi-loading-mark). The macOS path was not checked in the repository.
steps: Turn on Reduce motion in macOS System Settings > Accessibility > Display (this path is an OS setting, not in the repository).
Open the side panel and send a message.
Watch the typing dots and loading mark: they should stop or barely move.
Compare with Expected.
S11.14.where: Side panel: typing dots, spinners and loading marks while a reply is pending

labels.text: How can I help you today?

S11.21.needs: a Japanese, Chinese or Korean input method on the Mac
S11.21.note: The Enter check uses isImeComposingKey in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts.
steps: Switch the Mac input method to Japanese (the input method is an OS setting).
Click the message box and type a word such as konnichiwa, then press Return to confirm the conversion.
Check that the message is not sent and the converted text stays in the box.
Press Return again and check that the message is sent. Compare with Expected.
S11.21.where: Chat: message box with a Japanese, Chinese or Korean input method

S11.22.needs: a Mac set to a non-English locale
S11.22.note: Formatting uses the browser locale through Intl with no fixed locale (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts). Only apps/extension/_locales/en exists, so words stay English. Which rows show dates was not fully traced.
steps: Set the Mac language and region to a non-English locale (an OS setting).
Click Recent chats and read the dates and times on the rows.
Compare the date and number formats with Expected.
Note that the labels stay in English because only the English catalog exists.
S11.22.where: Side panel > Recent chats (dates and times on chat rows)

S11.24.note: The tab-picking step after Attach tabs was not traced in code; the plural keys are in messages.json (spTabsAttached_one and _other).
steps: Have one Chrome tab open besides the side panel, click Add attachment, then Attach tabs, and attach it.
Read the chip text: it should say 1 tab attached.
Attach a second tab the same way; the chip should now say 2 tabs attached.
Compare with Expected: singular and plural forms are correct.
S11.24.where: Chat > Add attachment > Attach tabs; then the attached-tabs chip above the message box

labels.text: Microphone access is blocked. Allow the microphone for AGI in Chrome site settings, then try again.

S11.25.needs: a microphone, and Chrome site settings access to block it
S11.25.note: Messages come from describeVoiceError in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/voice.ts. The app has only the English catalog, and no other language was found in apps/extension/_locales.
steps: In Chrome site settings, block the microphone for the extension.
Click Voice input in the message box.
Read the message that appears; it should say the microphone is blocked.
Compare with Expected.

S11.27.note: The menu is built in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts around the spModelsMenuLabel use; the exact long label that appears depends on the models available to the account.
steps: Drag the side panel to its narrowest width.
Open the Available models menu from the model button.
Look for long model names and effort labels: they should wrap or cut off cleanly without covering other controls.
Compare with Expected.
S11.27.where: Chat > the model button under the message box (menu labelled Available models)
